mapper.select: SELECT office_history_id AS officeHistoryId, office_id AS officeId, company_id AS companyId, floor_no AS floorNo, office_number AS officeNumber, login_id AS loginId, email, phone, status_code AS statusCode, TO_CHAR(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS createdAt, TO_CHAR(updated_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS updatedAt, TO_CHAR(withdrawn_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS withdrawnAt, changed_by_admin_id AS changedByAdminId, actor_type_code AS actorTypeCode, actor_id AS actorId, change_type_code AS changeTypeCode, change_reason AS changeReason, TO_CHAR(valid_from, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS validFrom, TO_CHAR(valid_to, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS validTo FROM office_history ORDER BY valid_from DESC, office_history_id DESC
